scripts.dev:butler: concurrently "npm run dev -w ceviwie-chilbi-butler" "npm run dev -w @ceviwie/chilbi-shared"
scripts.dev:pos: concurrently "npm run dev -w ceviwie-chilbi-pos" "npm run dev -w @ceviwie/chilbi-shared"
scripts.build:butler: npm run build:shared && npm run build -w ceviwie-chilbi-butler
scripts.build:pos: npm run build:shared && npm run build -w ceviwie-chilbi-pos
scripts.build:all: npm run build:shared && npm run build --workspaces --if-present
